B"H

# Discovered Actual File Plan

The Awtsmoos reveals the real vessels before any abstraction claims authority;
Awtsmoos.com therefore grows by additive covenants first, preserving every existing family's sovereignty.

## Direct Evidence

- `geelooy/api/_awtsmoos.derech.js` is a small federation facade and does not need modification.
- `geelooy/api/core/ApiFamilyCatalogData.js` is the explicit family metadata catalog and is currently clean in Git.
- API families are routed by their own `_awtsmoos.derech.js`; `geelooy/api/runtime/_awtsmoos.derech.js` demonstrates the preferred small delegating route style.
- Social already contains mature entity types, relationship edge types, activity pointers, visibility policy, and provenance schemas.
- Drive already has focused typed resource clients with inheritance around `AtzilusResourceClient`.
- Shared file-intent already demonstrates versioning and size/age budgets.
- AI tool schemas demonstrate dynamic action/schema descriptions but the current file is too large to touch safely in this mission.
- `geelooy/style/universal-ui/` is clean in Git and already owns classless native-control fallback styling.
- Existing universal UI has good 44px/focus/reduced-motion ideas but still uses gradients, blur, strong shadows, and lacks complete semantic coverage for prose, lists, tables, code/media, fieldsets, and mobile dialog/sheet behavior.
- `geelooy/style/foundation/` contains useful safe-area/type/spacing behavior but also theme-specific dark/gold/cyan assumptions and some space-indented legacy CSS; it will be read/reused conceptually, not modified in this pass.
- Concurrent agents are actively editing auth, social shell, and geelooy-app styles; those files are excluded from this mission's writes.

## Existing File Approved For Complete Rewrite

### `geelooy/api/core/ApiFamilyCatalogData.js`

Add a `portal` family descriptor while preserving every existing family record exactly in meaning and order where compatibility requires it. This is the only federation-core integration file.

### Universal UI files

Rewrite the complete existing clean universal UI entry and owned modules to remove futuristic defaults and add stable semantic coverage:

- `geelooy/style/universal-ui.css`
- `geelooy/style/universal-ui/tokens.css`
- `geelooy/style/universal-ui/raw-fields.css`
- `geelooy/style/universal-ui/raw-choices.css`
- `geelooy/style/universal-ui/raw-actions.css`
- `geelooy/style/universal-ui/raw-feedback.css`
- `geelooy/style/universal-ui/motion.css`

Add focused new semantic modules instead of bloating those files:

- `geelooy/style/universal-ui/raw-prose.css`
- `geelooy/style/universal-ui/raw-lists.css`
- `geelooy/style/universal-ui/raw-tables.css`
- `geelooy/style/universal-ui/raw-media-code.css`
- `geelooy/style/universal-ui/raw-structure.css`
- `geelooy/style/universal-ui/responsive.css`

Every selector remains zero/low specificity and limited to classless/unclaimed elements or explicit Portal roots so specialist components retain authority.

## New Portal Server Contract Modules

Create under `geelooy/api/portal/contracts/`:

- `PortalContractLimits.js` — immutable depth/size/query/render budget constants.
- `PortalResourceEnvelope.js` — minimal stable resource envelope normalization/validation.
- `PortalTypeDefinition.js` — namespaced type definition/lifecycle/schema/capability normalization.
- `PortalActionDefinition.js` — stable action IDs, input/output schema, confirmation, idempotency, job semantics.
- `PortalRelationship.js` — typed direction/target/link relationship descriptors.
- `PortalQueryDefinition.js` — bounded query/operator/sort/page normalization.
- `PortalErrorResource.js` — structured safe errors and field issues.
- `PortalProvenance.js` — source kind, verified/inferred status, references, transformation metadata.
- `PortalJob.js` — honest job states/progress/stages/cancel/retry/output descriptors.
- `PortalTransformation.js` — accepted/input/output/config/determinism/side-effect/fanout descriptors.

## New Portal Server Registry + Adapter Modules

Create under `geelooy/api/portal/registry/`:

- `PortalTypeRegistry.js` — deterministic type registration/read/list with version/lifecycle metadata.
- `PortalBuiltinTypes.js` — Portal resource-type and API-family type definitions.
- `PortalCapabilityRoot.js` — discoverable links/capabilities/envelope version.

Create under `geelooy/api/portal/adapters/`:

- `ApiFamilyResourceAdapter.js` — wraps existing `ApiFamilyCatalogData` records into real Portal resources without changing `/api/catalog`.

Create under `geelooy/api/portal/core/`:

- `PortalReadService.js` — read-only orchestration for root/types/API-family resources.
- `PortalHttpHandlers.js` — translate service outputs/errors to dynamic-route responses.

Create `geelooy/api/portal/_awtsmoos.derech.js` using the proven small route delegation pattern.

## New Portal Client Engine

Create under `geelooy/scripts/awtsmoos/portal/`:

- `PortalApiClient.js`
- `PortalResourceNormalizer.js`
- `PortalRendererRegistry.js`
- `PortalRendererSelection.js`
- `PortalFieldRegistry.js`
- `PortalDom.js`

Create renderers under `.../renderers/`:

- `PortalGenericRenderer.js`
- `PortalCollectionRenderer.js`
- `PortalApiFamilyRenderer.js`
- `PortalUnknownRenderer.js`
- `PortalInspectorRenderer.js`

Create app modules under `geelooy/portal/scripts/`:

- `PortalApp.js`
- `PortalState.js`
- `PortalNavigation.js`
- `portal.js`

Create a real surface:

- `geelooy/portal/index.html`
- `geelooy/portal/portal.css`

The page must load `/style/universal-ui.css`, browse the real Portal type registry, render real API-family resources, expose generic and developer inspector modes, and remain usable at narrow mobile widths.

## New Tests

Create focused Node tests under `geelooy/api/portal/tests/` for:

- minimal/maximal envelope
- unknown extensions/forward compatibility
- namespaced type validation and lifecycle
- action confirmation/idempotency semantics
- bounded queries
- structured errors
- provenance/job/transformation contracts
- API-family adapter equivalence
- type registry/capability root
- route-handler read behavior where direct handler testing is possible

Create lightweight client tests where DOM-free modules permit it under `geelooy/portal/tests/`.

## Runtime Audit Extension

Only after the Portal page exists, inspect the existing `scripts/runtime_quality/domMetrics.mjs` again and, if necessary, completely rewrite it or split it to add findings for unstyled navigation list markers, unlabeled dialogs, and viewport-escaping code/pre. Do not modify it before seeing the actual Portal rendering.

## First-Pass Boundary

This pass intentionally implements read-only universal discovery and rendering plus complete stable HTML fallback styling. Mutation/action execution, persistent jobs, live event streams, pipelines, and domain-specific write adapters will have fully defined contracts but no fake execution backends. Future capabilities must attach to real domain services rather than pretend to exist.

## NEXT_ACTION

Read the exact current `ApiFamilyCatalogData.js` once more for whole-file replacement fidelity, then write all additive Portal contract/registry/adapter/service/route files and the catalog replacement before any tests. After server code, write the universal UI and Portal client/page, then perform the mandatory full readback and delta pass.
